query: What is our standard Leave and Time-Off Policy for full-time employees?
reference_answer: Full-time employees receive 18 days annual leave, 6 days casual leave, 12 days sick leave, and 5 days bereavement leave. Requests must be submitted via PeopleHub.

query: How many days of annual leave can an employee carry forward to the next year?
reference_answer: Employees may carry forward up to 10 unused annual leave days to the following calendar year.

query: How much notice is required when requesting annual leave?
reference_answer: All annual leave requests must be submitted via PeopleHub with at least 3 working days notice.

query: How many casual leave and sick leave days are allocated annually?
reference_answer: Employees are entitled to 6 days of casual leave and 12 days of sick leave annually.
